# Fast Read

> Fast Read is a free, open-source speed reading web application that uses RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) to help users read documents faster by displaying one word at a time with an optimal recognition point.

## Features

- [Speed Reading with RSVP](https://fastread.marcelodiani.online/): Read documents at 300-1500 words per minute
- [Multiple Format Support](https://fastread.marcelodiani.online/): Supports PDF, EPUB, Markdown, HTML, and plain text files
- [Study and Speed Modes](https://fastread.marcelodiani.online/): Study mode pauses on code/images, Speed mode skips them
- [Customizable Themes](https://fastread.marcelodiani.online/): Dark, Light, Sepia, and High Contrast themes
- [Text-to-Speech](https://fastread.marcelodiani.online/): Native browser TTS with adjustable speed
- [Keyboard Controls](https://fastread.marcelodiani.online/): Full keyboard navigation for hands-free reading

## How It Works

1. Paste text or upload a document (PDF, EPUB, MD, HTML, TXT)
2. Words are displayed one at a time using RSVP technique
3. The Optimal Recognition Point (ORP) highlights the key letter in each word
4. Adjust speed from 50 to 1500 WPM using keyboard or slider
5. Use Study mode to pause on code blocks, or Speed mode for uninterrupted reading

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js 15 and React 19
- Also available as a Tauri 2 desktop app
- Open source on GitHub
